data.llm_justification: The combination of zero active days, zero BLs received, zero reply rate, and zero hotleads over 30 days represents a near-total platform disengagement that compounds severely — the only counter-signal is a high clickstream count (2172) and a decent CQS (78), but these likely reflect historical or passive activity rather than current engagement, and the rule-based model underweights the simultaneous collapse across all activity dimensions.
llm_interactions: Zero active days + zero BLs received + zero reply rate = complete activity blackout, not just partial disengagement
High clickstream (2172) is decoupled from any transactional or communication activity, suggesting bot/automated traffic or stale session data rather than genuine seller intent
CQS of 78 indicates historically healthy catalog, making the sudden total inactivity more anomalous and likely indicative of deliberate abandonment rather than gradual drift
No hotleads + no enquiry flow + no PNS answer rate creates a reinforcing loop where platform has no mechanism to re-engage this seller organically
